messages:
Marta R: quick sync: prototyping a compact "cost flipbook" card for console. flips between raw per-token burn, amortized cache-savings, and per-model/unit econ for canary vs stable.
Jamal: keep time window & cohort filters when flipping. current view resets them.
Marta R: yes, state saved as view+sample_rate+cohort. default sample=0.1.
Ash: show uncertainty for amortized savings (+/-) so PMs don't overreact.
Sana: routing skew matters (dedicated vs shared pools). propose a "routing skew" badge + normalize toggle.
Jamal: normalization live at sample rates ok; full-res needs nightly pre-agg or on-demand recompute. add "recompute full" button.
ops-bot: @SRE can infra export routing-destination breakdown per cohort (7d, 1h granularity)?
DevEx Bot: metric names per telemetry contract: tokens_total,tokens_cached,cache_hits,model_sku_cost.
Marta R: plan: single backend endpoint with mode param (mode=amortized) to keep auth/caching consistent. I'll draft RFC and prototype card.
